Write on various maintenance points for carding.
Calculate the speed of Air Jet looms if the weft insertion rate is 1600 mts/min and width of loom is 76”.

A weaving unit is set to produce following varieties of fabrics during the year: • 2/2 twill fabric – 18.00 lac mts, Reed/pick – 66/46 • Fabric Width – 42 inches • Loom Speed – 140 rpm • Efficiency % - 78 Calculate the number of shuttle looms required to produce the said quantity of fabric.

Calculate number of winding machines each having 60 spindles and running at 1200 mts/min with 85% efficiency to be required to supply wound packages having 40s yarn count per day to meet with the requirements of a unit having 5 warping machines running at 550 mts/min with 60% efficiency and having 450 ends/beam with a set length of 25000 mts/beam.

86,000 meters of following quality of grey fabric are to be produced: • Reed/Pick – 72/42 • Warp/Weft – 44s/36s • Fabric Width – 52 inches • Contraction % - 5 Calculate weight of Warp & Weft yarns in kgs.
Prepare production schedule to produce 1200kgs/shift of combed warp and 1000 kgs/shift of combed weft of 80s Ne .
A fabric of 61 inch width is produced with 82s reed. The denting order is 2 ends per dent in body and 3 ends per dent in selvedge. The width of selvedge is 1.5 cm on each side. Calculate total ends.

In Spinning mill blow room is working with following parameter: Hank of Lap delivered = 0.0014, Delivery speed= 40 m/min, Efficiency=84%, Lap length = 40 mts. Calculate production of blow room in terms of kgs/Shift.

A twin delivery draw frame is running at 800 m/min delivering sliver with hank of 0.12. If efficiency of draw frame is 90%, calculate production of draw frame in terms of kgs/shift.

An OE Spinning Plant has requirement of 25000 kg of 8sNe per month (30 working days at 24 hrs per day). Calculate no. of OE spindles required to produce above count if TM is 4.6, Rotor Speed is 75000 RPM with 96% Efficiency. Also find out number of bobbins if weight of each is 1.25 kg.

Write down critical points of daily maintenance of automatic shuttle loom.

Write critical maintenance points for sizing machine.
Derive equation to work out number of pirns required per loom per hour and amount of fabric produced per pirn.

A fabric is to be produced having 40 inch R.S. on 72s reed with 2 ends per dent in body and 3 ends per dent in selvedge. The selvedges are ¼ inch on each side. The fabric has a weft way stripe of 50 threads per repeat comprising of 10 dark threads and 40 white threads. Find out requirement of dark and white yarn per 100 linear m of fabric. The PPI are 60. The selvedges are white.
An automatic loom shed has 120 looms running at 220 rpm with 93% efficiency. The PPI are 96. The contraction in length is 5%. Find out linear warp consumption rate per day.

A warping machine runs at 500 mpm with 55% efficiency. No. of bobbins in creel is 540. Total ends in weaver's beam are 5400. Length of warp on weaver's beam is 2000 m and on warper's beam is 22000 m. Find out the time after which the creel will be exhausted if the count is 2/80s and the weight of yarn on bobbin is 1.4 kgs.

Find out for how many days 20 projectile looms (of 130 inch max reed space) can be kept working if the speed is 360 RPM with 91 % efficiency. The contraction in fabric is 6%. The fabric to be woven has 100 gsm. (Ignore selvedges)
